verdicts.reason: Both handle the portrait canvas the same way: they keep the tinted panel and centred text, but the corner marks (X, slashes, circle) drift off the panel's corners into the photo. In both, the circle sits on a man's face and the top X is jammed near the canvas edge, so the framing device from the original is lost. A's larger panel and headline give stronger hierarchy and fill the format better. B's smaller panel and text leave more empty photo margin, and its bottom marks look even more stranded.
